summary: The authors reported 31 hypothalamic genes after adjusting for body weight. HypoExplorer estimates the overall KO-minus-WT difference in the same four knockout and four wild-type mice. The public-source review found no author genotype-only result for those animals, so concordance remains unassessed. The proposal passed validation. [Published study](https://doi.org/10.3389/fnagi.2022.1035572)
openIssues: A direct comparison would require the authors’ genotype-only hypothalamus DE table for GSM6523623–GSM6523630, with gene identifiers, effects, raw and adjusted P values, and model settings.
